data.text: Draw time and souls tokens and apply as enemy's stat-penalty permanents. + Put a bonus effect from the Library over a known location.

logic.description: Reworked 2026-10-29. With an enemy in contact: Time and Souls dice (World) land as −die penalty tokens on the target's stats. With no enemy in reach: a random building / artefact (Shrine, Sphere of Fire, School, Sacred Land, … — a bonus tile token with an item label, general_ux_token_generated) appears on a random free tile within 2 hexes.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: One point-buy per penalty element (elem_time, elem_souls) on the caster stat; each die lands as a −die token on the target stat behind that element. Total dice rolled for the penalties.
Each penalty token value is the highest die of its roll; that is the power an enemy must beat to remove it (Rule 24).
No enemy in reach → a random feature token (item + element + value from the FEATURES catalog) on a random free tile within 2 hexes (deterministic from the reveal salt).
general_ux_tokens: one token per element on a tile — the new one stands only if it is bigger than the one already there.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_time (the element family that defines the effect).
element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_souls (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
